ambiguous_question: Show each course with its number of sections.
clarification_target: Whether courses with no sections should be included.
user_resolution: Include every course, using zero for courses with no recorded sections.
resolved_question: Show every course with its number of sections, including courses with no sections with a count of zero.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name, COUNT(s.section_id) FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Sections AS s ON c.course_id = s.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of enrolments per course?
clarification_target: Whether courses with no enrolment-course records should contribute zero.
user_resolution: Include all courses and treat courses with no enrolment-course records as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of enrolment-course records per course across all courses, treating courses with none as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(enrolment_count) FROM (SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(sec.student_course_id) AS enrolment_count FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec ON c.course_id = sec.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id)

ambiguous_question: Who is the most recently registered student in the enrolment data?
clarification_target: Whether to consider all students or only students with an enrolment.
user_resolution: Consider only students with at least one enrolment record.
resolved_question: Who is the most recently registered student among students with at least one enrolment record?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.date_first_registered FROM Students AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Enrolment AS se WHERE se.student_id = s.student_id) AND s.date_first_registered = (SELECT MAX(s2.date_first_registered) FROM Students AS s2 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Enrolment AS se2 WHERE se2.student_id = s2.student_id))

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of degree programs per department?
clarification_target: Whether departments with no degree programs should contribute zero.
user_resolution: Include all departments and treat departments with no degree programs as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of degree programs per department across all departments, treating departments with none as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(program_count) FROM (SELECT d.department_id, COUNT(dp.degree_program_id) AS program_count FROM Departments AS d LEFT JOIN Degree_Programs AS dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id)

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of courses taken by students?
clarification_target: Whether to include students with no course enrolment and whether to aggregate per student.
user_resolution: Count course-enrolment records per student and include students with none as zero.
resolved_question: Across all students, what is the average number of course-enrolment records per student, treating students with none as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(course_count) FROM (SELECT s.student_id, COUNT(sec.student_course_id) AS course_count FROM Students AS s LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON s.student_id = se.student_id LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec ON se.student_enrolment_id = sec.student_enrolment_id GROUP BY s.student_id)

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of courses in student enrolments?
clarification_target: Whether to average course rows per enrolment and include enrolments with no courses.
user_resolution: Compute the course count for every enrolment and include enrolments with no courses as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of course records per student enrolment, treating enrolments with no courses as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(course_count) FROM (SELECT se.student_enrolment_id, COUNT(sec.student_course_id) AS course_count FROM Student_Enrolment AS se LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec ON se.student_enrolment_id = sec.student_enrolment_id GROUP BY se.student_enrolment_id)

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of course results per transcript?
clarification_target: Whether transcripts with no course-result rows should contribute zero.
user_resolution: Include every transcript and treat transcripts with no course-result rows as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of transcript-content rows per transcript, treating transcripts with none as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(result_count) FROM (SELECT t.transcript_id, COUNT(tc.student_course_id) AS result_count FROM Transcripts AS t LEFT JOIN Transcript_Contents AS tc ON t.transcript_id = tc.transcript_id GROUP BY t.transcript_id)

ambiguous_question: What is the average enrolment count for degree programs?
clarification_target: Whether degree programs with no enrolments should contribute zero.
user_resolution: Compute one enrolment count per degree program and include programs with no enrolments as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of enrolment records per degree program across all programs, treating programs with none as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(enrolment_count) FROM (SELECT dp.degree_program_id, COUNT(se.student_enrolment_id) AS enrolment_count FROM Degree_Programs AS dp LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id GROUP BY dp.degree_program_id)

ambiguous_question: List the students represented in enrolment records.
clarification_target: Whether repeated students should be preserved for separate enrolments.
user_resolution: Return one student last name for every enrolment record, preserving repetitions.
resolved_question: List one student last name for every student enrolment record, preserving repeated names.
gold_sql: SELECT s.last_name FROM Student_Enrolment AS se JOIN Students AS s ON se.student_id = s.student_id

ambiguous_question: List the courses represented in student course-enrolment records.
clarification_target: Whether repeated courses should be preserved for separate enrolment-course rows.
user_resolution: Return one course name for every enrolment-course record, preserving repetitions.
resolved_question: List one course name for every Student_Enrolment_Courses record, preserving repeated names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec JOIN Courses AS c ON sec.course_id = c.course_id

ambiguous_question: List the semesters represented in student enrolment records.
clarification_target: Whether repeated semesters should be preserved for separate enrolments.
user_resolution: Return one semester name for every enrolment record, preserving repetitions.
resolved_question: List one semester name for every student enrolment record, preserving repeated semester names.
gold_sql: SELECT sem.semester_name FROM Student_Enrolment AS se JOIN Semesters AS sem ON se.semester_id = sem.semester_id

ambiguous_question: List the departments represented by degree programs.
clarification_target: Whether repeated departments should be preserved for separate degree programs.
user_resolution: Return one department name for every degree-program record, preserving repetitions.
resolved_question: List one department name for every degree-program record, preserving repeated department names.
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name FROM Degree_Programs AS dp JOIN Departments AS d ON dp.department_id = d.department_id

ambiguous_question: How many students are represented in enrolment records?
clarification_target: Whether to count enrolment records or distinct students.
user_resolution: Count distinct students, not enrolment records.
resolved_question: How many distinct students have at least one student enrolment record?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM Student_Enrolment

ambiguous_question: How many courses are represented in student course-enrolment records?
clarification_target: Whether to count enrolment-course rows or distinct courses.
user_resolution: Count distinct courses, not enrolment-course records.
resolved_question: How many distinct courses occur in Student_Enrolment_Courses records?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses

ambiguous_question: How many departments are represented by degree programs?
clarification_target: Whether to count degree-program records or distinct departments.
user_resolution: Count distinct departments that have at least one degree program.
resolved_question: How many distinct departments have at least one degree-program record?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

ambiguous_question: How many course results are represented in transcripts?
clarification_target: Whether to count transcripts or individual transcript-content result rows.
user_resolution: Count individual course-result rows in Transcript_Contents.
resolved_question: How many course-result rows are recorded in Transcript_Contents?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Transcript_Contents

ambiguous_question: Which courses did that student take?
clarification_target: The student being referenced.
user_resolution: I mean Frida Huel.
resolved_question: Which courses did Frida Huel take?
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON s.student_id = se.student_id JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec ON se.student_enrolment_id = sec.student_enrolment_id JOIN Courses AS c ON sec.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.first_name = 'Frida' AND s.last_name = 'Huel'

ambiguous_question: What is that department's description?
clarification_target: The department being referenced.
user_resolution: I mean the computer science department.
resolved_question: What is the description of the computer science department?
gold_sql: SELECT department_description FROM Departments WHERE department_name = 'computer science'

ambiguous_question: When was that transcript issued?
clarification_target: The transcript being referenced.
user_resolution: I mean transcript 5.
resolved_question: When was transcript 5 issued?
gold_sql: SELECT transcript_date FROM Transcripts WHERE transcript_id = 5

ambiguous_question: What city does that student currently live in?
clarification_target: The student being referenced.
user_resolution: I mean Warren Gleichner.
resolved_question: What city does Warren Gleichner currently live in?
gold_sql: SELECT a.city FROM Students AS s JOIN Addresses AS a ON s.current_address_id = a.address_id WHERE s.first_name = 'Warren' AND s.last_name = 'Gleichner'
